decisionContext.capacity: Independent non-paid traffic acquisition remains the highest commercial constraint; continue alongside design. No paid media or contracts without owner approval.
decisionContext.finishStandard: Read autopilot/PRODUCT_FINISHING_STANDARD_2026-10-09.md. Every screen, field, sentence and CTA must serve the user's immediate job, with premium consistent UX, real price data and QA. Do not call project finished from isolated feature PRs.
